{{Tabs|History = No}} {{Removed|date = 29th of October 2020}} {{Unreleased|planned = was never properly released and was only left unused in-game}} {{For|[[Undead Miner]]|other uses of [[Void (Disambiguation)|Void]]}} {{TowerInfobox |image = VoidMinerIcon.png |unlockcost = Exclusive |basecost = {{Money|800}} |basesellingprice = {{Money|266}} |placement = Ground |basedamage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]0 |damagetype = None |basefirerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0 |baserange = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]3 |baseincome = {{Corruption|1}} |hidden_detection = N/A |immune = None |footprint = Average }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Void Miner''' was an exclusive tower mostly gotten by developers of the game and, at the time, testers of the game. The '''Void Miner''' worked similarly to the [[Farm]]. At the end of each wave, it would generate a specific number of corruption. This was added to a corruption counter that appeared on the tower itself. Upon reaching 2,000 corruption generated, the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] would be guaranteed to happen, even if the requirements were not met, allowing for it to be triggered outside of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. If 2,000 corruption were not generated, nothing would happen, as corruption had no other purpose. ==Upgrades== Do note the upgrade costs here are not 100% accurate and are instead based on known tower sell costs, known costs, and supposed stats listed for it in the past. {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Corrupted Vision|Cost = {{Money|600}}|Image = [[File:Minigunner1.png|100px]]|Information = +{{Corruption|1}} Corruption Sell Price changes to {{Money|466}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 2|Upgrade Title = Unknown Title|Cost = {{Money|900}}|Image = [[File:Minigunner2.png|100px]]|Information = +{{Corruption|1}} Corruption Sell Price changes to {{Money|766}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 3|Upgrade Title = Unknown Title|Cost = {{Money|1,250}}|Image = [[File:Minigunner3.png|100px]]|Information = +{{Corruption|2}} Corruption Sell Price changes to {{Money|1,183}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 4|Upgrade Title = Unknown Title|Cost = {{Money|2,500}}|Image = [[File:Minigunner4.png|100px]]|Information = +{{Corruption|4}} Corruption Sell Price changes to {{Money|2,016}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 5|Upgrade Title = Unknown Title|Cost = {{Money|5,500}}|Image = [[File:Minigunner6.png|100px]]|Information = +{{Corruption|6}} Corruption Sell Price changes to {{Money|3,850}}}} ==Statistics== Do note the total costs here are not 100% accurate and are instead based on known tower sell costs, known costs, and supposed stats listed for it in the past. {{neow| $TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$ $TPI$ = $TP$ / Corruption $COST$ = 800; 600; 900; 1250; 2500; 5500 $FSE-UPGRADE$ = Corrupted Vision; Unknown Title; Unknown Title; Unknown Title; Unknown Title $FSE-UPGRADEICON$ = File:Minigunner1.png; File:Minigunner2.png; File:Minigunner3.png; File:Minigunner4.png; File:Minigunner6.png $FSE-META$ = Unavailable; File:VoidMinerIcon.png $WREF$ = Calculated as Upgrade Cost ÷ Corruption Gain. $R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$
